note: NRT months and months after FIT_END_CAP are excluded from fitting and validation. MdAPE uses months with >= 10 actual MODIS hotspots; WAPE uses all months.
selection_rule: lowest leave-one-year-out MdAPE on region-month counts, mean over regions

modis_drift_check.note: Archive months after the fit period, not used for fitting. Positive = actual MODIS is below the harmonized (MODIS-equivalent) prediction. Cause unverified.
